sources.title: Self-attention Does Not Need O(n^2) Memory
sources.note: Rabe & Staats 2021; O(1)/O(log n)/O(sqrt n) streaming attention variants; backward via checkpointing; 59x inference, 32x backprop memory reduction at n=16384

sources.title: Online Normalizer Calculation for Softmax
sources.note: Milakov & Gimelshein 2018 (NVIDIA); single-pass running-(m,d) recurrence; the algorithmic primitive that enables FlashAttention's single-pass tiling; 1.3x Softmax speedup, 5x fused Softmax+TopK

sources.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
sources.note: Dao et al. 2022 (NeurIPS); O(N) activation memory via tiling + recomputation; HBM writes Theta(N^2*d^2/M) vs standard Theta(Nd+N^2); 3x GPT-2 speedup; backward recomputes S/P from (l,m)

sources.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
sources.note: Dao 2023 (ICLR 2024); warp-partitioning fix lifts MFU from 25-40% to 50-73%; 225 TFLOPs/s on A100; ~2x over FA1; same O(N) memory; non-matmul FLOP reduction via loop reorder

sources.title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision
sources.note: Shah et al. 2024; Hopper-specific: TMA+warp-specialization ping-pong, FP8 block quantization + incoherent processing; 740 TFLOPs/s FP16 (75%), 1.2 PFLOPs/s FP8; 1.5-2x over FA2; 2.6x lower FP8 error

sources.title: PyTorch scaled_dot_product_attention — SDPA Backends
sources.note: Official PyTorch SDPA tutorial; 4 backends: MATH/FLASH_ATTENTION/EFFICIENT_ATTENTION/CUDNN_ATTENTION; sdpa_kernel() context manager; silent math fallback risk; 38x performance cliff math vs optimized

sources.title: xFormers memory_efficient_attention
sources.note: Meta 2024; CUTLASS FMHA kernel implementing Rabe & Staats O(N) streaming attention; PyTorch SDPA EFFICIENT_ATTENTION backend; supports custom bias tensors unlike FA2; broader GPU coverage

sources.title: SageAttention: Accurate 8-Bit Attention for Plug-and-play Inference Acceleration
sources.note: Zhang et al. 2024 (Tsinghua, ICLR 2025); INT8 QK^T + FP16 PV; channel-wise K smoothing; 2.1x over FA2; INFERENCE-ONLY; SA2 (2411.10958) adds INT4 per-warp for 3.1x; included as training contrast

sources.title: Ring Attention with Blockwise Transformers for Near-Infinite Context
sources.note: Liu, Zaharia, Abbeel 2023 (ICLR 2024); sequence sharded across D devices in ring; KV rotation pipelined behind GEMM = zero extra comm cost; O(L/D) per-device KV memory; foundation for context parallelism in Megatron-LM

sources.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
sources.note: Kwon et al. 2023 (SOSP); vLLM; fixed-size KV page blocks, near-zero fragmentation; 2-4x throughput vs FasterTransformer; INFERENCE-ONLY; included as explicit training contrast (KV cache != training activations)
